text:
Sam: quick post — ran the slot-sizing per-cardset probe this morning. goal: find max_tokens_per_batch that maximizes throughput without kernel-fit regressions for A10/T4/L4/A100/H100. notes below.

Maya: nice, can you paste the run config and profiler dumps?

Sam: pasted below. used 30m steady-state bursts, 60/40 split short/long seqs, kv cache warm for 80% of requests. queue policy = fair-priority w/ burst_slots=16.

Jess: high-level findings:
- A100/H100: safe to push max_tokens_per_batch -> 48 for our 8k models, p50 token latency improved ~12%, throughput +18%. kernel selection favored fp16 fused attention kernels.
- A10: best at 32 tokens/batch for mixed seqs; pushing to 48 triggered kernel fallback to slower aten path for 1-2% of slices -> CPU spill up + 9% p90 regression.
- L4/T4: fragile around 24-28 tokens; kv-frag increases with packing_ratio > 0.7 causing kernel mismatch and higher GPU SM idle.

Rick: by "kv-frag" do you mean KV-cache page fragmentation (uneven KV pages causing small-kernel launches)?

Jess: exactly. we observed many tiny KV segments when prefix reuse was high. profiler shows many <64-token KV slices causing micro-kernel path.

Sam: config snippet used (ran on canary pool):

```json
{
  "cardsets": {
    "a100": {"max_tokens_per_batch": 48, "slot_size": 1024},
    "h100": {"max_tokens_per_batch": 48, "slot_size": 1024},
    "a10": {"max_tokens_per_batch": 32, "slot_size": 768},
    "l4": {"max_tokens_per_batch": 26, "slot_size": 512},
    "t4": {"max_tokens_per_batch": 24, "slot_size": 512}
  },
  "batching": {"packing_ratio_target": 0.65, "burst_slots": 16, "queue_policy": "fair-priority"}
}
```

Maya: did you try forcing kernel-selector to prefer fused kernels even if packing_ratio slightly low? might reduce regressions on A10.

Jess: yes, we tried selector override for A10 -> fused preferred. outcome: lowered p90 by 6% but increased GPU memory pressure and occasional OOM on 4/1000 runs when KV fragmentation hit heavy tails.

Rick: what's the util / token/s numbers?

Jess: perf snapshot (median across runs):
- A100: 14.2k tokens/s, GPU util 82%, p50 token-lat 18ms
- H100: 15.0k tokens/s, GPU util 85%, p50 16.8ms
- A10: 6.4k tokens/s, GPU util 68%, p50 44ms (48-token case), p90 up 9%
- L4: 5.9k tokens/s, GPU util 60%, p50 51ms; kv-frag ratio 0.31
- T4: 5.1k tokens/s, GPU util 55%, p50 58ms; packing_ratio variance high during spikes

Hannah: thanks, these numbers are useful. propose action items:
1) set conservative max_tokens for L4/T4 (24/26) in default profiles, with canary override.
2) add a kernel-selector safelist that triggers only under packing_ratio > 0.7 to avoid OOMs.
3) add KV-frag metric to console (kv_frag_ratio percentile) and alert when >0.25 on sustained windows.

Sam: agreed. also suggest queue tweak: prefer capacity-stealing for short seqs when packing_ratio < 0.5 to avoid fragment tail amplification. essentially steal small slots from long-window queue.

Maya: how about adaptive token_budget targets? if packing_ratio < target, reduce max_tokens_per_batch by 10% on the fly (cooldown 30s).

Rick: that sounds reasonable. we should simulate with the load-generator first. can we add a sim flag to the runtime so we can run 1h synthetic traces against current selector+queue policies?

Jess: deploy-bot started an automated sim: perf-test/canary/slot-sz-probe-2734567890.

deploy-bot: perf-test/canary/slot-sz-probe-2734567890: started 2734567905. ETA 1h. logs -> https://internal.perf/redwood/canary/2734567890

Hannah: if sim looks good, let's roll conservative tweaks to default profiles and monitor kv_frag_ratio + p90. can we add postmortem hooks to capture kernel fallback traces for any p90 regression >7%?

Sam: will add hook. i'll also push an RFC for slot-sizing-by-cardset with rollout plan (canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%) and runbook on kernel-fallback alerts.

Maya: thx. one last note: include model-length distribution in the dashboard so operators can correlate packing_ratio drops with real traffic (not just synthetic).

Jess: good call. i'll include a short PR to console metrics.

Sam: closing for now. will update thread when sim finishes and attach profiler flame samples. :thumbsup:
